note: Config of tools/fwstack.py for the s1 images (the new 0.3.0 firmware, built with FW_S1: fwbuild.json s1.pocket; build/s1/<layout>/<variant>). Same format as tools/stack.json, plus 'stand_in': a call to one of these functions counts at least the listed opaque depths, because in the new firmware's skeleton they are weak defaults (core/sched/sched_stubs.c) for code not written yet; the bound must not shrink because a body is missing. When the code lands, its stand-in goes and the real body is measured. The report labels numbers as stack.json's do: MEASURED, PROXY, MODELLED. Since 2026-10-11 the dispatcher, the job step and the board work are real code (their stand-ins went); the probe images keep the probe's own hook bodies. fatal_halt and audio_tick_begin (the song engine's hook) are weak defaults in core/dispatch/disp_stubs.c with stand-ins.
skip_ranges: brain blob (.brain_irom): not walked; its depth is the MEASURED @brain
cf.bin + pad + rodata.bin (.wram_cf): brain helpers and tables, counted in @brain

@c4b_overlay.label: MEASURED
@c4b_overlay.basis: Measured 572 B (check B1 of tests/equiv/cache4b.py: the deepest store the stub and the overlay make below the stack top over a whole first boot), kept at 1,024 B as the bound. Test build 4b's WRAM boot overlay (board/pocket/boot/c4b_ovl.c + core/wavpack, linked apart, so this tool does not walk it) is entered by boot_cache_boot from crt0 with MIE = 0 before any level exists: the -fstack-usage chain c4b_ovl_main 144 + wvbank_unpack 144 + WavpackUnpackSamples 48 + unpack_samples 112 + get_words 80 + bs_read 16 + the read callback = 560 B (measured frames, -Os; c4b_ovl_main was 128 before a later fix to the overlay), a 1.8x margin; the overlay itself refuses to start unless sp is 512 B clear of its stack-floor scratch (c4b_ovl.ld)

@brain.label: MEASURED
@brain.basis: measured in the Unicorn emulator: the deepest stack of the brain (its own frames + the cf.bin helpers it calls) over 5,971 calls in two fight scenarios (224 B in both). The brain runs with MIE = 1 (zz_buddy.c run_call).

@chip_song_tick.label: PROXY
@chip_song_tick.basis: deepest AUD chain (TIM14 ISR -> the synth tick -> the sequencer step -> the row reader -> the module command -> event_post: 368; deepest AUD root 400). PROXY: the cart chip's own call chain, written by our team from our own study of how the cart behaves, one function for each routine on it, compiled for RV32IM -O2 with the 0.2.6 toolchain, with the -fstack-usage frames summed along the chain. It stands for a straight port of the chip's call chain, not for our port

s1.what: the new firmware (the 0.3.0 design on MCU interface v1.0): L1 l1_mei (MEI, closed) > L2a l2a_mti (MTI, MEI open) > L2b l2b_msi (MSI, MEI + MTI open) > L2c (inside L2b, MSI open again: a second L2b may nest) > L3 l3_thread (from crt0 and the board boot; since 2026-10-15 the CPU MATE brain call is the thread's); one trap entry s1_trap_entry (80 B frame per level); exceptions on top of any open level. Real code is measured; hooks not written yet count at their stand-in depth

levels.name: thread
levels.basis: reset entry: s1_crt0 -> brd_boot -> l3_thread (MIE on from the end of the boot): the brain call and TEST's diagnostics (both in the thread since 2026-10-15) and the idle housekeeping

levels.name: msi
levels.basis: L2b: the tick slices, the tick end + held posts, and L2c last (sched_l2c_once: one job; there is no firmware decoder: the RTL decodes)

levels.name: msi_l2c
levels.basis: an L2b nested on the L2b that runs L2c (a job) with MSI open again (a tick start during a job; in earlier versions also a SEND during a decode, or a decoder request). Counted as a whole second l2b_msi on top of the outer one at its deepest path: conservative (the outer one is inside sched_l2c_once then, and the nested one skips L2c)

levels.name: mti
levels.basis: L2a: the wheel and its callbacks, the urgent tick promotion

levels.name: mei
levels.basis: L1: ack, read, hold or dispatch, SEND

levels.name: exc
levels.basis: an exception where interrupts are open (an exception inside L1 adds the same 80 + its frame on top of L1's depth: not chained, covered by the margin; see docs)
